node3's enp8s0 given persistent static 172.31.98.2/24 via NetworkManager; ping from node3 to 172.31.98.1 succeeds

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node2 on lan-a through node1
selected_evidence.summary: Forced node3 to route 10.100.55.11 via node1's lan-b IP; ping succeeded with ttl=63 (one hop through node1); tcpdump on node1 showed the ICMP traffic ingress on vtnet2 and egress on vtnet0, proving cross-zone forwarding
